findings.summary: Threads/pthread linkage missing from both spdlog and spdlog_header_only cc_library targets
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:183 target_link_libraries(spdlog PUBLIC Threads::Threads) and CMakeLists.txt:204 target_link_libraries(spdlog_header_only INTERFACE Threads::Threads). Neither elements/spdlog/BUILD.bazel:spdlog nor :spdlog_header_only has linkopts=["-pthread"] or a threads dep. The generated .pc file includes -pthread in Libs: but that does not propagate to Bazel dependents.

findings.summary: All benchmark targets are absent — no bench/BUILD.bazel exists
findings.evidence: bench/CMakeLists.txt defines four executables: bench (bench.cpp), async_bench (async_bench.cpp), latency (latency.cpp, links benchmark::benchmark), formatter-bench (formatter-bench.cpp, links benchmark::benchmark). SPDLOG_BUILD_BENCH=OFF was baked in, but the targets themselves are completely absent from the Bazel workspace; there is no bench/BUILD.bazel.

findings.summary: All test targets are absent — no tests/BUILD.bazel exists
findings.evidence: tests/CMakeLists.txt defines spdlog-utests (20+ source files, Catch2, add_test with RUN_SERIAL) and spdlog-utests-ho (header-only variant). SPDLOG_BUILD_TESTS=OFF was baked in, but neither target nor any cc_test rule exists anywhere in the converted workspace.

findings.summary: linkopts in example/BUILD.bazel contains compiler flags (-DNDEBUG, -O3, -O2, -g) which are not valid linker options
findings.evidence: example/BUILD.bazel:30-44 places -DNDEBUG, -O3, -O2, -g in linkopts for all build_type select arms. These are compiler flags (c.f. CMake's CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE sets them at compile time, not link time). Passing -DNDEBUG/-O3 to the linker driver is either silently ignored or causes unexpected LTO interactions; the cmake side never applied build-type flags as linker flags.

findings.summary: CMake config files (spdlogConfig.cmake, spdlogConfigVersion.cmake, spdlogConfigTargets.cmake) have no Bazel equivalent
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:345-353 uses configure_package_config_file + write_basic_package_version_file + install(EXPORT spdlog ...) to install three CMake integration files into lib/cmake/spdlog. No Bazel rule in the converted workspace generates or installs any of these, removing find_package(spdlog CONFIG) compatibility for downstream consumers.

findings.summary: pkg-config file is generated but marked private and wired to no install rule
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:339-340 configures spdlog.pc and installs it to ${pkgconfig_install_dir} (lib/pkgconfig). The Bazel conversion generates gen_spdlog_pc via write_file but sets visibility=["//visibility:private"] and never references it from any pkg_install or filegroup rule, so it is unreachable by any downstream install target.

findings.summary: example_header_only binary target is entirely absent
findings.evidence: example/CMakeLists.txt:20-23 defines add_executable(example_header_only example.cpp) linked to spdlog::spdlog_header_only when SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE_HO is set. SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE_HO=OFF was baked in, but the target does not exist at all in elements/spdlog/example/BUILD.bazel, meaning the capability is permanently lost rather than just disabled.

findings.summary: Android 'log' system library not linked for Android targets
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:231-234 conditionally calls target_link_libraries(spdlog PUBLIC log) and target_link_libraries(spdlog_header_only INTERFACE log) when ANDROID is set. No equivalent @platforms//os:android select() arm adding -llog appears in elements/spdlog/BUILD.bazel.

findings.summary: MinGW ws2_32 linkage missing from example target
findings.evidence: example/CMakeLists.txt:15 target_link_libraries(example PRIVATE spdlog::spdlog $<$<BOOL:${MINGW}>:ws2_32>). The Bazel example/BUILD.bazel has no select() arm adding -lws2_32 for Windows/MinGW targets.

findings.summary: DEBUG_POSTFIX 'd' for debug builds is not captured
findings.evidence: CMakeLists.txt:188 set_target_properties(spdlog PROPERTIES DEBUG_POSTFIX d) causes debug builds to produce libspdlogd.a. The Bazel spdlog cc_library has no equivalent; debug builds produce libspdlog.a, making debug/release artifacts indistinguishable by filename.
